label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
buildType: performance (not debuggable, R8 off: JNI entry points)
changes: Framing a track or section eases the camera there over 900 ms (centre in Mercator, zoom and tilt together, MapLibre's ease curve), as the website's fit; a touch on the map stops it. Te Araroa's previous and next glide from section to section.
Te Araroa's previous and next keep the sheet at its height (it no longer drops to the compact stop and comes back up).

Te Araroa's name along the trail is laid out again on the render thread for every frame the camera moves (was every 100 ms on a background thread, with its letters fixed to one anchor in between), so it follows its curve smoothly. It uses its whole curve: points outside the loaded terrain take heights between their neighbours' (NativeBridge.projectCurve) and terrain in front of part of the curve no longer cuts it short, so the name stays at the curve's middle, as MapLibre's line-center names on the website, instead of sliding along it.

Track sheet: a layout pass during a slide (content arriving) no longer snaps the sheet to its end and back; the map is resized once, before a slide down or after a slide up, never mid-slide; a drag starts where the finger is (no jump by the touch slop); the map fills the screen behind the sheet while it is dragged. When the map is resized, what was at the middle of the old view stays where it is on screen, so the map no longer jumps as the sheet settles.

tests.kotlinJvm: all pass: 341 tests, 6 skipped as before (new: LabelPlacementTest.aCurvedNameIsLaidOutAgainFromItsWholeCurveKeepingOtherNames)
tests.rust: cargo test -p ridgeline-renderer: all pass; GPU example label_occlusion passes (Vulkan, headless)

nativeLibraries: rebuilt for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 (new JNI entry projectCurve), stripped
